family.description: This family the N-terminal region of the Betacoronavirus polyprotein which contains non-structural protein 1 (Nsp1) from Betacoronavirus lineage A. This protein is important for viral replication and pathogenesis [[cite:PUB00094116],[cite:PUB00097618]]. It suppresses the host innate immune functions by inhibiting type I interferon expression and host antiviral signalling pathways.
family.name: Betacoronavirus, lineage A, NSP1
